data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 510 reported an opening gross claims outstanding position (closing 2014) of GBP 1,080.595m. The syndicate recorded favourable prior-year development, with the 2013 underwriting year improving by GBP 36.9m due to favourable claims development (claims settling for less than prior reserves), resulting in an overall release of approximately 3.4% of opening gross claims outstanding. No quantified gross movements by individual LOB were provided in the narrative; named large 2015 loss events (Shoreham Airshow, Tianjin explosions, California Wildfires, UK floods) were discussed but not quantified against prior-year reserves.
raw_causal_phrases: favourable claims development on prior years
claims settling for less than their loss reserves
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development amount taken from the Underwriter's Report narrative for Syndicate 510 (explicitly states 'improved by GBP 36.9m'). The narrative does not explicitly state whether this GBP 36.9m is a gross (insurance liabilities) or net (after reinsurance) figure; gross movement could not be unambiguously located in a dedicated 'movement in prior year provision' note for Syndicate 510. Opening reserves were taken from the Balance Sheet liabilities 'Claims outstanding' prior-year (2014) comparative column. No reliable gross prior-year movement note or an explicit gross claims development total for 2013 & prior was found; therefore the prior-year movement confidence is reduced and the figure should be treated as inferred from narrative.
